covers: sib8-p512-aut3 (ic.pipeline, wwalk ... sib=8,pool=512,aut=3) against rho-cubic (rho.cubic, A = 6) on the j0b7 sessions at p = 34, 37, 40 bits (five curves each) of this directory

rho_reference.protocol: PROTOCOL.md (frozen at 4ae92d4a40): rho-cubic, ecbench rho.cubic, the walk on {+-zeta3^i(P)} (A = 6) of the j = 0 curve's order-3 automorphism, named as the matched rho
rho_reference.unit: S = GAE / sqrt(r) per run (ecbench.gae), mean over the 180 paired measured runs of one size; the band adds w GAE per unpriced native operation
rho_reference.binary_or_process: ecbench sha256 cb49203e769721be2da6347ecb778e5e8933761c6ce91e29b2e33e8197a76846; both arms in the same session per size (same spec, workloads, targets and seeds)
rho_reference.gae_band_size: p = 40 bits (sessions/j0b7-40), the largest size; every size in gae_band_by_size
rho_reference.gae_band_reading: AGENTS.md 5a applied alike to both arms: cost.unpriced counts, plus the counted table and sibling work (table_insert_attempts, sibling_second_points, sibling_lift_products), plus one native operation per aut=3 canonicalisation (tw_aut_canonicalisations), as rho-cubic's canonicalisations_uncharged are priced. The committed band.rs reading omits the last term (validator-report.json erratum E1) and is given as gae_band_by_size.*.committed_reading.
rho_reference.order_note: Unresolved at every size under both readings: sib8-p512-aut3 is below rho-cubic at w = 0 (0.886 / 0.901 / 0.929) and above it at w = 0.1 and w = 1. No ranking of the two arms is supported.
